messages:
zoe: FYI alert: preview invoice dashboard showing a small but steady upward bias for tenants routed through resolver-canary since 14:20 UTC. not huge but persistent.
max: noticed that too. looks correlated with route-resolution refreshes every 30s.
claire: any deploys around then? ops-bot: deploy 9998887775 to resolver-canary finished at 14:18 UTC.
zoe: ok deploy timing matches. hypothesis: duplicate attribution when resolver returns transient aliases during refresh. could be double-emitting billing events for the same request.
max: quick check - preview consumer dedupe key is request_id only. if resolver changes route_id mid-flight and clientlib doesn't preserve request_id, we get two events.
claire: mitigation: pause canary and toggle resolver to sticky-cache mode (prefer existing mapping for 60s). can ops flip that?
max: i can flip, but need to confirm we won't impact latency. sticky-cache=true applied to canary at 14:24 UTC.
ops-bot: feature-flag sticky-cache toggled for resolver-canary by max at 14:24 UTC.
zoe: thanks. for recovery: billing, can preview results be frozen for affected tenants while we run a dedupe pass?
billing: we can hold automatic application for previews where route_source=resolver-canary. need list of tenant ids/time window.
max: i can export rough list from request logs for 14:15-14:30 where resolver_host=canary and preview_delta != 0.
claire: longer-term: change counting contract so that only final_deliver events increment invoice counters; interim or early attributes go to telemetry only. that will require small protocol bump but reduces these races.
zoe: agree. also add a dashboard metric: "preview-delta-by-resolver-version" and alert if >0.3% for 10m.
billing: agreed on hold. i'll draft a credits-run playbook if dedupe finds real duplicates.
max: opening ENGPLAT-9999 to track fix + dedupe job, assigning to me + zoe.
ops-bot: ticket ENGPLAT-9999 created by max  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-9999
zoe: keep this thread updated with the tenant export; will follow up in the ticket. :thumbsup:
